audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic, high-pitched male voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin over a bouncy, upbeat electronic pop BGM featuring bright synthesizers and a steady 4/4 drum machine beat. The speaker's arousal is high, conveying immediate excitement about the exhibition. (2) As the video cuts quickly between merchandise items, the speaker delivers short, punchy descriptions of each product, synchronized with the visual transitions. Subtle 'pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects are mixed in to emphasize the rapid montage pace. (3) The BGM maintains its constant tempo and major tonality, providing a cheerful and welcoming atmosphere. The narrator's speech density remains high, filling almost every second with vocal content to match the 17-second overview theme. (4) The audio concludes with a final invitation delivered with a rising intonation, as the BGM fades out quickly on the last frame, leaving a lingering sense of friendly hospitality.
